mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies as you head out near the Military Ridge State Trail, with temperatures sitting at 44 degrees and a waxing crescent moon overhead.

In city news, Verona police were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th following a report of a burglary in progress. Officers located a suspect, 19-year-old Luis Aragon-Zaring, who was taken into custody after a handgun was recovered at the scene. He is currently facing charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

Today you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow is a busy day in Verona with Hop Haus trivia, Quizmasters trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day trivia at Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, we have the downtown farmer's market, live music at Paddy Mac's, and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee on Wednesday.
On Wednesday, September 10th, officers responded to a burglary in progress where they apprehended a suspect after a weapon was discharged at the scene, though thankfully no injuries occurred.
Culver's of Verona is currently undergoing a remodel, but the team will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
